title: Are you spotting? (rebuild)
look: dark commercial gym, warm amber tungsten practicals, deep shadows, light haze, natural skin texture, 9:16 vertical
set_map: Flat bench runs north-south. A lies supine, head at the north end directly under the barbell. B stands at the north end behind A's head, facing south toward A's feet. Rack uprights either side of A's head. Practical lights overhead.

cast.A: lean man early 30s, curly dark hair, light stubble, fitted black t-shirt, black shorts, white trainers
cast.B: very muscular man late 20s, dark skin, close-cropped hair, black stringer vest, grey sweat shorts, phone in both hands

continuity: same two men, same wardrobe, same gym, same amber grade as shot 1, no face morphing, no outfit change

shots.angle: side-on from the east wall, eye level
shots.action: A presses a loaded barbell, it stalls halfway up, arms trembling; B stands behind A's head eyes locked on his phone screen, thumb scrolling
shots.audio: gym hum, plates clink, A strains

shots.angle: looking straight up past the bar
shots.action: from A's eyes: the shaking bar fills the lower frame, B looms above lit by his phone, thumb scrolling

shots.angle: low angle on B from bench height
shots.action: B glances down for a split second, then straight back to his phone, both hands still holding it
A's face reddens, he exhales and closes his eyes in defeat as the bar sinks toward his chest
